_meta.name: English
_meta.about: Texts of the vault pane and band. For another language: copy this file under the language's code (de.json, es.json…), translate the values, keep the keys and the {variables}. The language is chosen in Administration.
pane.title: obsidian-mcp-router
command.description: Show the router's vaults (primary, secondaries, available)
command.openedUnreachable: Vault pane opened, but the router does not answer: {error}
startup.refusedToast: Vault pane: Claude Code blocks its calls to the router (permissions). Type /vaults to see what to allow.
refused.writesWarning: {rules} — these rules also let the model change the binding and the config without an auto-mode check.
refused.write: {by} the pane's call to {tool}: nothing was changed. For the pane's clicks to work, add to permissions.allow in Claude Code's settings: {writes}
refused.read: {by} the pane's call to {tool}: the router was not asked. For the pane to show, add to permissions.allow in Claude Code's settings: {list}. For its 🌐 and 🪟 links: {links}. For its clicks to change the binding: {writes}
error.timeout: the router does not answer (timed out)
error.browser: Browser: {error}. The 🪟 button opens the same interface here.
error.innerBrowser: Built-in browser: {error}. The 🌐 button opens the same interface in your browser.
error.obsidian: Obsidian could not be started for {name}: {error}
error.stale: The binding changed while sending (another session): nothing was written, the pane is refreshed.
error.spellings: The router config holds this workspace under several spellings (a hand edit): nothing was sent. Repair the binding first.
error.configUnread: The router could not read its config again: nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
error.primaryChanged: The binding changed meanwhile (primary: {primary}): nothing was sent, the pane is refreshed.
error.primaryChosen: A primary was chosen meanwhile ({primary}): nothing was sent, the pane is refreshed.
add.title: Add a vault
legend.claude: Remote: opens in the built-in browser
legend.chromeOff: Chrome: Claude in Chrome is not on
admin.chromeOn: On: the planet opens a remote vault in Chrome (debug mode).
admin.chromeOff: Not on. Install the Claude in Chrome extension in Chrome, turn it on in Claude (Settings › Connectors, or the /chrome command), then check again.
error.chrome: Chrome could not open the page: {error}
error.chromeNoTab: Claude in Chrome gave no tab
register.descLocal: Obsidian on this PC, through the Local REST API plugin.
register.descRemote: A server reached through the WireGuard tunnel.
register.descRemoteTunnel: A server reached through the WireGuard tunnel {tunnel}.
primary.title: PRIMARY:
primary.definition: This project's default vault: Claude reads and writes it without asking.
primary.none: No primary vault: choose one below.
primary.unreachable: Unreachable: is WireGuard on? is the container running on the server?
primary.imported: Binding imported from a .env, never confirmed.
primary.sessionLocked: Session locked to the primary: the secondaries do not answer.
primary.routerLocked: Router locked to {vault} for this session (lock_vault): the other vaults do not answer.
secondaries.title: SECONDARIES: {count}
secondaries.definition: Vaults Claude can consult on top of the primary, each with its own write right: 🔒 read-only · ✋ write if you agree · ✏️ read and write.
tunnel.down: WireGuard seems down: the remote vaults are not available.
tunnel.hint: Turn the tunnel on, then ↻ Refresh.
wg.title: WireGuard
wg.inactive: installed, but no tunnel is on. Turn your tunnel on to reach the remote vaults.
wg.absent: not installed. A remote vault needs WireGuard.
wg.toastInactive: WireGuard is off: your remote vaults will not answer. Turn your tunnel on (Vaults pane → Administration).
register.title: Register an existing vault
register.name: Name
register.keyNote: The key goes straight into the router config; the pane clears it once sent.
register.needWireguard: Turn WireGuard on to register a remote vault.
register.phone: Registering is done from the computer.
register.invalidHost: The IP address is empty or holds forbidden characters.
register.invalidLocalHost: A local vault is registered on this machine: 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1.
register.invalidRemoteHost: A remote vault goes through the tunnel: give its private address (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x or 100.64-127.x).
register.invalidPort: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
register.invalidUiPort: The web UI port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
register.invalidKey: Paste the API key of the vault's Local REST API plugin.
register.descriptionLocal: Local vault registered from the vault pane
register.descriptionRemote: Remote vault registered from the vault pane
unregister.title: Take a vault out of the router
unregister.hint: Only vaults no workspace is bound to can be taken out. A local vault is disabled; its files stay untouched.
update.title: Plugin update
update.unknown: latest version unknown (GitHub does not answer)
update.done: Plugin updated to v{version}: open a new session to use it.
update.partial: Plugin updated to v{version} (GitHub announces v{latest}): open a new session to use it.
update.unchanged: Nothing changed: Claude Code still has v{version}. Its marketplace may not offer the latest yet.
update.unverified: The update commands succeeded, but the installed version could not be read back: check with "claude plugin list".
command.setupDescription: Set up a vault: create an Obsidian vault with its conventions, or register one
command.setupOpened: Vault setup opened in the pane.
setup.toast: No vault for this project: type /vault-setup to create or register one.
create.title: Create an Obsidian vault
create.name: Name
create.languages: Vault languages (comma-separated codes, e.g. en, fr)
create.bind: Bind this project to the new vault
create.conventionsPending: The conventions could not be installed in {name} (the vault must be open in Obsidian): {error}
create.noSeal: The router returned no sealed preview: nothing was created.
create.invalidLanguages: The vault's languages: ISO 639-1 codes of 2 letters, each once, separated by commas (e.g. fr, en).
action.pauseNotHere: Recorded for {name}, but this session's router still applies the previous state (another session changed it after it started): restart the session for it to apply here.
action.pauseNeedsRouter: Pausing needs router v0.107.0 or later, and this session's router is v{version}: the app keeps the router it started before the update. Quit Claude completely and start it again (a new session is not enough).
secondaries.pauseHint: ▶ active: a press pauses it · ❚❚ paused: a press resumes it as it was set (🔒 read-only, ✋ write if you agree, or ✏️ read and write)
band.noOpen: Nothing to open {name} with: no known local folder, no web UI.
hooks.title: This workspace’s hooks
hooks.intro: For {workspace}. The read-only hooks run everywhere; the others only where you switch them on.
hooks.global: Still installed machine-wide in ~/.claude/settings.json: it runs in every workspace. Remove it with setup-vault.mjs --uninstall-hooks to set it here.
hooks.whenApplied: Applies from the next event; session-start hooks, from the next session.
hook.hot-cache-load: Loads the vault’s hot.md at session start and after a compaction.
hook.workspace-briefing: Says at session start which vaults this workspace is bound to.
hook.decisions-recall: Recalls the settled decisions that touch your request.
hook.wiki-query-first-nudge: Reminds Claude to search the wiki before answering (≈2k tokens per message).
hook.session-auto-journal: Writes a journal of each session into the vault (wiki-meta/Sessions/).
hook.wiki-autocommit: Commits every vault write to git.
hook.vault-link-linter: Blocks a reply whose vault links are not clickable.
hook.hot-cache-update-prompt: Blocks the end of a turn until hot.md is refreshed after a vault write.
hook.doc-propagation-checker: After a git commit, flags docs (CHANGELOG, wiki) behind the code.
hook.vault-doc-startup-check: At session start, flags vault docs behind the code.
hook.check-router-update: Once a day, checks GitHub for a newer router version.
